changes.structural_truth_isolation: Localization defaults truth association off and creates no truth subscriptions in that state; a live graph audit rejects control-plane truth subscribers.
changes.async_moveit_selection: A pure coordinator rejects stale callbacks, invalidates drifted poses and caches, and distinguishes backend contention from path infeasibility.
changes.development_receipt_schema: Schema v3 records every selection event and separates simulation scoring events from runtime control.
changes.zero_motion_feasibility: An immutable sweep selects only scenes with at least two stable ripe tracked targets that pass the existing MoveIt connected-path evaluator.
changes.formal_schema_v2: Formal acceptance and atomic claims bind the matrix, materialized scenes and worlds, model, runtime configuration, Git commit, one behavior attempt, cleanup and unsafe-motion count.

decision.current_primary_blocker: Only one of 18 untouched qualification scenes contained at least two stable ripe MoveIt-feasible tracks; five were required before any behavior run.
next_required_work: Use the development evidence to correct the mismatch between randomized plant/fruit placement and the arm's conservatively connected MoveIt workspace without relaxing safety thresholds.
Add a reproducing test for the scene-generation feasibility contract, freeze the behavior change, and advance qualification to the next unused hundred-seed block.
Run five once-only continuous-harvest trials only after a fresh qualification block selects five eligible scenes; keep the formal matrix sealed until that gate passes.
